verdict.rationale: A first-run guided setup walkthrough is a fair question for a work-management SaaS like Wrike, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never describes an onboarding wizard, product tour, or guided workspace setup. The template library and the developer-doc steps (implement OAuth, call endpoints) are adjacent features, not a guided walkthrough, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
